strategies.name: Aave Supply
strategies.description: Supplies USDC directly to Aave V3's lending pool, earning variable supply interest as aUSDC. Accrued AAVE incentive rewards are claimed via Aave's IncentivesController, swapped to the vault asset, and compounded back into the position.

strategies.name: Lido wstETH Vault
strategies.description: Holds wstETH as `want`, earning Ethereum consensus-layer staking rewards that accrue directly into the wstETH exchange rate. No separate reward token to harvest - yield is realized by periodically redeeming the appreciated wstETH balance back to the vault asset.

strategies.name: Sky Lockstake
strategies.description: Locks SKY into Sky's Lockstake Engine and delegates the position to a reward farm. Farm emissions are periodically claimed via getReward() and compounded back into the locked position - this is the Lockstake mechanism, not the passive Sky Savings Rate.

strategies.name: Uniswap LP Pool
strategies.description: Provides USDC/WETH liquidity to a reward-pool-gauged pair. Trading-fee and incentive rewards are harvested, swapped back into both LP legs, and redeposited to compound the position.

strategies.name: Morpho Vault
strategies.description: Deposits USDC into a curated Morpho ERC4626 vault via mint()/previewDeposit() to avoid dust loss. No on-chain reward token - vault yield accrues into the share price and is realized by redeeming appreciated shares; incentive rewards are claimed separately off-chain via Merkl.

strategies.name: Venus Supply
strategies.description: Supplies USDC to a Venus Protocol vToken market and enters the market via the Comptroller. XVS rewards are claimed from Venus's RewardDistributor, swapped to the vault asset, and compounded. Legacy StratFeeManagerInitializable strategy, not BaseAllToNativeFactoryStrat - carries the real 0.1% withdrawal fee that family defaults to.

strategies.name: Stargate LP Farm
strategies.description: Deposits USDC into a Stargate V2 pool and stakes the resulting LP token in Stargate's Chef farm. STG emissions are claimed, swapped to the vault asset, and compounded; profit unlocks linearly over a 1-day lockDuration to prevent harvest sandwiching.

strategies.name: Compound V3 Supply
strategies.description: Supplies USDC directly to a Compound V3 (Comet) market. COMP rewards are claimed via CometRewards, swapped to the vault asset, and compounded back into the position.

strategies.name: Curve Convex Vault
strategies.description: Deposits a Curve LP token into a Convex reward pool (falls back to the Curve gauge directly if no Convex pool is set for that pid). CRV and CVX emissions are claimed, swapped to the vault asset, and compounded back into the LP position.

strategies.name: BaseSwap LP Position
strategies.description: Holds a BaseSwap LP position as an NFT (BaseSwapNFT.createPosition/addToPosition, not a plain ERC20 stake). Harvested BSX rewards enter a 15-day vesting escrow before being redeemable; once vested they're swapped to WETH and split back into both LP legs to compound the position.

strategies.name: Balancer Gauge Pool
strategies.description: Deposits Balancer V2 BPT (want) into either a Curve-style gauge or, when a valid Aura pid is configured, into Aura's Booster/BaseRewardPool for boosted rewards. Rewards are claimed via the gauge's claim_rewards (plus BAL minting through the pool's pseudo-minter) or Aura's getReward(), then swapped to native and rejoined into the Balancer pool through IBalancerVault.joinPool. Extends BaseAllToNativeFactoryStrat, so protocol-level deposit/withdraw fees are hardcoded to zero.

strategies.name: Balancer Gyro Pool
strategies.description: A variant of the Balancer/Aura strategy purpose-built for Gyroscope two-token pools: it reads live token rates via getTokenRates() to compute a balanced two-sided join ratio (_calcSwapAmount/_multiJoin) instead of a single-sided deposit. Like its sibling it can route staking through either a Curve-style gauge or Aura's Booster depending on the configured pid, claiming BAL (and AURA when boosted). Its stratName() literally returns the typo'd string 'BalancerGryo' as found in the source.

strategies.name: Balancer V3 Pool
strategies.description: Targets Balancer V3 pools using the V3 Vault's unlock/settle/addLiquidity flow (balancerJoin, callable only from within a Vault-initiated unlock callback) instead of the legacy V2 joinPool call. It can stake want via a gauge or an Aura Booster, or hold want unstaked in 'holdWant' mode, and additionally exposes a claim() entrypoint that pulls incentive tokens from Merkl's on-chain claimer contract for the pool's active reward campaigns.

strategies.name: Curve Convex CRV Stake
strategies.description: Single-asset strategy for cvxCRV: it stakes the cvxCRV want token directly into Convex's StakedCvxCrv contract and claims rewards via getReward(). Harvested CRV and CVX are swapped back to WETH through hardcoded Curve pools (crvPool/cvxPool), with any additional owner-configured reward tokens routed through Curve's generalized exchange_multiple router or Uniswap V3. Extends StratFeeManagerInitializable and explicitly sets withdrawalFee = 1 (out of the WITHDRAWAL_MAX denominator) in its initializer.

strategies.name: Curve Convex CVX Stake
strategies.description: Single-asset strategy for CVX itself: it stakes CVX into Convex's cvxRewardPool-style staking contract (IStakedCvx) and claims rewards via getReward(address, claimExtras, false), with an owner-toggleable claimExtras flag to opt into extra bonus reward tokens beyond the base cvxCRV payout. It extends the non-factory BaseAllToNativeStrat, reusing the generic all-to-native harvest/swap machinery rather than the Curve-router-specific swap logic used by the other Convex strategies here.

strategies.name: Curve Convex Staking
strategies.description: A generic template for staking any Convex-wrapped Curve LP token: both want and the staking contract are set at initialize time rather than hardcoded, letting it cover many Convex pools. It claims rewards from the configured IStaking contract, swaps hardcoded CRV/CVX balances through dedicated Curve pools, and supports additional owner-configured reward routes via Curve's exchange_multiple router or Uniswap V3 paths. Extends StratFeeManagerInitializable with withdrawalFee = 1 set explicitly in initialize, same as its cvxCRV sibling.

strategies.name: Curve Convex Staking (Fraxtal)
strategies.description: The Fraxtal-chain counterpart of the Convex staking strategy: it stakes want into a Fraxtal IStaking contract via stakeFor() and, uniquely among this group, registers the strategy with a Frax delegation registry (setDelegationForSelf/disableSelfManagingDelegations) during initialization and turns harvestOnDeposit on by default. Extends BaseAllToNativeFactoryStrat, so it inherits zero-fee deposit/withdraw handling and the generic all-to-native reward-swap pipeline rather than the Curve-router-specific logic of the mainnet Convex staking strategy.

strategies.name: Curve Convex Fraxtal Pool
strategies.description: Curve/Convex switchable LP strategy on Fraxtal that stakes the Curve LP want token in either the Convex L2 booster's reward pool or the native Curve gauge, minting CRV via the on-chain minter (when the gauge is whitelisted) and claiming any extra curve gauge rewards or the Convex reward pool's getReward() on harvest before routing everything to native (WETH) and compounding back into more LP. It initializes with harvest-on-deposit turned on and includes an optional delegate.xyz vote-delegation hook set during initialization.

strategies.name: Curve Convex L2 Pool
strategies.description: The generic Curve/Convex L2 factory strategy: deposits the Curve LP want into the Convex L2 booster's reward pool when a pid is set, otherwise stakes directly in the Curve gauge, minting CRV via the gauge factory's minter and claiming extra curve gauge rewards or the Convex reward pool's getReward() on harvest. It also exposes a merklClaim() function to pull Merkl-distributed token incentives into the strategy, and enables harvest-on-deposit by default.

strategies.name: Curve f(x) Convex Vault
strategies.description: Routes an f(x) Protocol gauge position through a per-strategy Convex proxy vault (created via IFxnVoterProxy.operator().createVault), depositing and withdrawing the fx LP want token into that vault and calling getReward(claimFxRewards, claimTokenList) to pull FXN gauge rewards and any Convex-side reward tokens, which are then swapped to WETH before recompounding. Unlike the factory strategies it explicitly fixes the withdrawal fee to 0 in its base initializer and defaults harvestOnDeposit to false.

strategies.name: Curve StakeDAO Vault
strategies.description: Wraps a StakeDAO v2 ERC-4626 vault: deposits and withdraws the want LP directly through the vault's deposit/withdraw functions, and on harvest claims both the vault's own reward token list (via sdVault.claim) and the StakeDAO Accountant's gauge-based harvest rewards (SDT plus underlying CRV emissions), tolerating accountant claims reverting when nothing is due. harvestOnDeposit is configurable at initialization and defaults to off unless explicitly enabled.

strategies.name: Beefy Reward Pool
strategies.description: Beefy's own strategy for staking BIFI in Beefy's reward pool: deposits BIFI want into IBeefyRewardPool, harvests by calling getReward() (paid out in WETH/native) plus any additional admin-whitelisted reward tokens, charges call/beefy/strategist fees out of the native balance, then swaps the remainder back into BIFI via the Beefy swapper and restakes it, using a 3-day linear profit-unlock (totalLocked/duration) to smooth reported balance. harvestOnDeposit defaults to false and must be explicitly enabled by the manager.

strategies.name: Kodiak Island LP
strategies.description: Stakes a Kodiak Island (concentrated-liquidity) LP token in its Berachain reward gauge, harvesting via gauge.getReward() and explicitly redeeming any accrued BGT balance to native BERA/WETH through the BGT contract's redeem() function, before swapping proceeds back into the pool's two underlying tokens and re-minting Island LP via getMintAmounts/mint. It enables harvest-on-deposit by default in its initializer.

strategies.name: Bunni AlienBase Farm
strategies.description: Deposits a Bunni concentrated-liquidity LP token (wrapping a Uniswap v3 position) into AlienBase's MasterChef, harvesting by calling chef.deposit(pid, 0) to pull the farm's emission rewards, then rebalances the swapped-back native into the pool's two underlying tokens at the position's current tick range using LiquidityAmounts math before redepositing through the Bunni hub. harvestOnDeposit is configurable at initialization and off by default.

strategies.name: GMX GLP Vault
strategies.description: Holds staked GLP, GMX's basket-of-assets index token backing the perps trading pool. On harvest it calls the GMX RewardRouter's handleRewards to claim GMX rewards, swaps the claimed GMX to WETH via the Beefy swapper, then mints and stakes more GLP with that WETH to compound.

strategies.name: GMX GLP Cooldown Vault
strategies.description: A GLP variant that adds an enforced withdrawal cooldown window: deposits and re-minting of GLP are blocked while `cooldown` is active until GLP's own cooldownDuration plus an extra buffer elapses, preventing griefing around GLP's native cooldown. Harvest calls the RewardRouter's compound() (restaking esGMX and multiplier points) and claimFees() (claiming native WETH fees), then mints more GLP with the WETH.

strategies.name: GMX GM Market
strategies.description: Holds a GMX v2 GM market token backed by a long and short collateral token pair. Harvest swaps any configured reward tokens to WETH, splits the WETH 50/50 into the market's long/short tokens, and submits an async createDeposit to the GMX v2 exchange; a permissionless afterDepositExecution callback then syncs balances, with newly minted GM linearly unlocked over a 7-day duration to resist front-running.

strategies.name: GMX Stake
strategies.description: Stakes GMX itself via the RewardRouter's stakedGmxTracker. Harvest calls handleRewards to claim WETH fee rewards and auto-stake esGMX and multiplier points, swaps any loose GMX to WETH, charges fees, then swaps the remaining WETH back into GMX and re-stakes it to compound the position.

strategies.name: Ichi Vault LP
strategies.description: Deposits into a single-sided ICHI vault LP token, staking it in an ICHI reward gauge. Harvest claims gauge rewards via getReward(), and the contract also exposes a permissionless merklClaim() to pull additional Merkl-distributed incentives; claimed rewards are swapped to WETH then to whichever single token (token0 or token1) the ICHI vault expects before redepositing.

strategies.name: Morpho Merkl Vault
strategies.description: Deposits directly into a Morpho ERC4626 vault. Unlike gauge-based strategies, its internal _claim() is a no-op since Morpho vault incentives are computed off-chain; rewards are instead pulled permissionlessly via a Merkl claimer using merkle proofs, and the vault's own want token can even be registered as a claimable reward via addWantAsReward().

strategies.name: Shadow Gauge Pool
strategies.description: Provides liquidity to a Solidly-fork Shadow DEX pair (stable or volatile) and stakes the LP in a gauge. Harvest claims gauge reward tokens, then specifically unwinds any xShadow (Shadow's escrowed governance token) held by the strategy — routing through the x33 auto-compounder wrapper when the exchange rate is favorable, or exiting directly to SHADOW otherwise — before swapping everything to WETH and re-adding liquidity.

strategies.name: Silo V2 Market
strategies.description: Deposits directly into a single Silo V2 lending market (an ERC4626-style isolated silo). Harvest claims SILO incentives from an optional IIncentivesGauge via claimRewards(), swaps them to WETH, and swaps back into the market's want asset to compound the position.

strategies.name: Silo Vault
strategies.description: Deposits into a Silo vault position and claims SILO incentives from an IIncentivesGauge, like SiloV2, but additionally wires up a hardcoded Merkl claimer at initialization so the strategy can permissionlessly pull extra Merkl-distributed incentive tokens via merkle proofs — a claim path SiloV2 does not have.

strategies.name: Pendle Market LP
strategies.description: Holds a Pendle PT/SY market LP token directly and claims accrued yield straight from the Pendle market via redeemRewards(), which is paid out in PENDLE. The strategy is a thin wrapper on BaseAllToNativeFactoryStrat with no custom deposit/withdraw logic, and exposes an additional merklClaim() entrypoint for pulling in Merkl-distributed incentive rewards tied to the pool.

strategies.name: Pendle Equilibria Boost
strategies.description: Deposits into an Equilibria-boosted Pendle position: the want token is staked through the Equilibria booster into a pid-specific reward pool, or, if pid equals the NO_PID sentinel, left as a raw Pendle market position. Harvesting claims from the Equilibria reward pool (or calls redeemRewards on the Pendle market directly when unboosted) and can optionally redeem locked xEQB into EQB through a time-delayed redeem queue.

strategies.name: Pendle Penpie Stake
strategies.description: Deposits into a Penpie-staked Pendle position by routing the Pendle market want token through Penpie's PoolHelper into PendleStaking, receiving a receipt token that tracks the staked balance. Harvesting triggers a market harvest once Penpie's harvest-time gap has elapsed, then calls MasterPenpie's multiclaimSpecPNP to collect the underlying Pendle market rewards plus, optionally, PNP itself.

strategies.name: Pendle Penpie Merkl Stake
strategies.description: A variant of the Penpie strategy that deposits the Pendle market want token through Penpie's PoolHelper/PendleStaking and claims rewards the same way via MasterPenpie's multiclaimSpecPNP, but adds a merklClaim() entrypoint for pulling in additional Merkl-distributed campaign incentives and supports enabling harvest-on-deposit at initialization.

strategies.name: Stargate Native Pool
strategies.description: Wraps native-asset deposits into Stargate V2's native pool: it unwraps WETH to native ETH, deposits into the StargateV2Router for LP tokens, and stakes those LP tokens in the Stargate V2 Chef. Harvest calls the Chef's claim() for reward tokens (STG), swaps them to native through the Beefy swapper, and the strategy explicitly sets its withdrawal fee to 0 on initialization.

strategies.name: Tokemak Autopool
strategies.description: Deposits into a Tokemak autopool: the want token is the autopool's vault share (rewarder.stakingToken()), which is staked in a Tokemak rewarder contract to earn TOKE. On harvest, native proceeds are swapped into the autopool's underlying deposit asset and re-deposited into the Tokemak vault to mint more want shares.

strategies.name: Velodrome Factory Pool
strategies.description: Deposits a Velodrome (Solidly-style) LP pair into that pool's gauge/reward pool and claims VELO via getReward(). On harvest, native is split and swapped into the pair's two underlying tokens - using stable-pool quoting logic when the pair is a stable pool - before being added back as liquidity through the Solidly router.

strategies.name: Velodrome Gauge Pool
strategies.description: Deposits a Velodrome LP pair directly into its gauge (IVelodromeGauge) and claims the gauge's output reward token, VELO, via getReward(). Unlike the factory-based strategy it has no stratName() override and instead runs on StratFeeManagerInitializable's fee model, toggling its withdrawal fee to 0 whenever harvest-on-deposit is turned on.

strategies.name: Abracadabra MimSwap Pool
strategies.description: Deposits into an Abracadabra MimSwap LP pool and stakes the LP token in the pool's gauge, claiming rewards via gauge.getRewards(). It explicitly enables harvestOnDeposit at initialization, and on harvest swaps native proportionally into the pool's two underlying tokens - using getReserves()-based quoting - before adding liquidity back through the MimSwap router.
